newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain hit by volatile currency.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain hit by volatile currency.

text.p: Volatile trading on the foreign exchange markets kept most players sidelined on the UK cash grain markets on Friday.
"Most people had taken a look at the way the foreign exchanges rates have been jumping around and decided to leave things alone until Monday," said a trader.
Traders on the fob market said buyers and sellers were around one stg apart and showing no sign of moving.
On the delivered market traders reported little activity ahead of the weekend.

Traded levels were around 0.50 to one stg down with milling wheat 11 percent protein in the London area fetching 117 stg for April/June while feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 95 to 96 stg for February.
On the weast coast 95 to 94.50 stg was paid for January and 97 stg for March.
Feed barley in East Anglia traded at 97.50 to 96 stg for February.
